FULL TEXT:
No:F (ANRF-PRJ/FR/CLB)KU/26 Date: 08.04.2026
Advertisement Notice.
Applications on prescribed format are invited from the eligible candidates for the below
mentioned position available under the Research project entitled “Evaluation of Genetic
Landscape of Cardioprotective Adaptations/Maladaptation’s in High Altitude Tribal
Populations of J and K: Insights for Targeted Therapeutic Interventions.” sponsored by
ANRF under ARG- 2025 scheme, Govt of India, New Delhi.
Position and Number Essential Qualifications Desirable Qualifications
Project Assistant (1) M.Sc in Clinical
Biochemistry/ Biochemistry/
Biotechnology with
minimum of 55% of marks or
equivalent CGPA grade.
• Working experience in Cell
culture and cloning techniques
• Profound knowledge of
medical lab technology
• Field experience in conducting
Clinical studies
• Candidates who have qualified
CSIR-UGC- NET Exam/ GATE or
other Equivalent
Exams (Preferable).
The application with full details (Name, age, working contact number, email ID, qualifications,
experience etc, Format is available on website) along with Photostat of relevant documents
should reach to the Office of Clinical Biochemistry by or before 20th Apr. 2026 or to concerned PI
as a single PDF file. The position is temporary and co-terminus with the tenure of the project.
The emoluments will be paid as per the ANRF guidelines vide: ANRF/OM/N01/2024, dated:14-
10-2024. The date of Interview to short listed candidates will be communicated through their
emails.
For any other query, please contact at email: fouzia_rashid@kashmiruniversity.ac.in
Sd/-
Prof. Fouzia Rashid (PI), Dept. of Clinical Biochemistry, University of Kashmir, Sgr.
Copy to:
1. Dean, Faculty of Biological Sciences, University of Kashmir
2. Dean Research, University of Kashmir
3. Head/In charge website, Department of Clinical Biochemistry, for uploading on departmental website
4. Director IT and SS for uploading on the university website
5. Media Advisor, Public Relations Centre, University of Kashmir with the request to publish the
said advertisement notice in one local daily for wide publicity (Greater Kashmir).
6. File.
